Maya: hi all, quick question from week 1 - my dental plan shows as 'waiting for verification' but i already uploaded enrollment confirmation. i also have a one-time relocation travel expense. do i need to wait until benefits are fully verified to submit the travel expense?
People Ops: hey Maya 1f44bf3fb you can submit relocation travel as an expense now (use 'Relocation - Travel' category). benefits verification only blocks claims that route through benefits card. reimbursements via Expensify will flow through normal finance queue.
Maya: cool, thanks. second thing - payroll shows my pay schedule as 'biweekly' but my offer said monthly payroll (i'm international hire). who should i ping?
Connor: hi Maya, i'm payroll ops. we default international hires to monthly if flagged during onboarding. can you DM me your employee id? i'll correct the schedule if it was incorrectly set.
Payroll Bot: reminder: tax docs required for payroll schedule changes. Please ensure W-4 (or local equivalent) is uploaded.
Benefits Team: we've reprocessed dental proof and set verification status to 'verified' for EID RWI-4222. card activation pending physical card mail (3-5 business days).
Maya: thanks! payroll schedule fixed too. appreciate the quick help :smile:
